title: Rename workbench staged retest flow
summary: Refines the Settings rename filter workbench so required fields are visually emphasized by media type, already-covered suggestions are dimmed and unselected, new missing terms are highlighted for staging, and a successful staged retest prepares the existing Save Settings review path.
reason: Operators need to see the initial failure, stage only genuinely new filter terms, retest against the staged draft, and then persist the filters through the existing backend-owned Save Settings flow.
behavior_before: The workbench could pass while still listing terms as stageable suggestions, source title was not visually prominent, inactive media-type fields were hidden rather than deemphasized, and staging suggestions left the terms in draft storage without a retest-to-Save-Settings handoff.
behavior_after: Source file/title and mode-specific required fields are emphasized, inactive media-type fields are disabled/dimmed, suggestion rows distinguish already-covered terms from stage-recommended new terms, staging updates only the draft, and a passing staged retest prepares the Settings patch for the normal Save Settings review.
